positive_traits: complete readable object or coherent full equipment kit
strong silhouette and useful three-dimensional assembly clues
clear material placement and load-bearing relationships
period-relevant typology with several comparable forms
active-service or reconstruction finish rather than excavation decay

replica_reconstruction.priority: preferred when well researched and visually clear
use_for: functional joins, hinges, lacing, overlap, backing, and load paths
active-service surface condition and healthy material color
fit, coverage, articulation, and scale on a complete object
screen_out: theatrical fantasy costume with no archaeological basis
modern hardware hidden under an ancient-looking surface
replica whose maker or evidence basis cannot be identified
over-polished ceremonial reinterpretation presented as ordinary field gear

use_for: proportions, sockets, tangs, hafting, overlap, coverage, and closure evidence
do_not_transfer: corrosion, patina, pitting, encrustation, burial staining, fading, cracks, or missing material
museum lighting, catalog composition, support mounts, labels, or background

automatic_reject_as_visual_driver: isolated fragment with no complete silhouette
shield boss without shield construction context
single armor-scale clump without wearable layout
duplicate crop of the same artifact
textile scrap without garment cut or assembly information

mandatory_exception.sling_throwing: A documented complete real sling remains required because sling silhouette is a severe model failure mode.
